paragraphs.text: Thanksgiving travelers in Pontotoc County have two different forecasts to plan around. Showers are likely Wednesday morning, with a 70% chance of rain over the course of the day. By Thanksgiving Day, the National Weather Service expects mostly sunny skies and highs in the mid-50s.

Rain is expected to move in late Tuesday night. The county forecast gives showers a 60% chance that night and puts the likeliest window after midnight. Wednesday afternoon should turn partly sunny, though showers remain possible. By Wednesday evening the rain chance drops to 20%.

The colder of the two holiday nights now looks to be Thursday. For the city of Pontotoc, forecasters put Wednesday night’s low near 35 degrees, Thanksgiving afternoon’s high near 53 and Thursday night’s low near 29. The county outlook calls for sunshine on Friday and highs in the upper 50s.

The forecast follows a record-tying Saturday at nearby Tupelo. The weather service recorded 77 degrees there at 3:08 p.m. on Nov. 21, matching the mark set on that date in 1933. The normal high for that date at Tupelo is 62 degrees.
